name: x3d-physx-bridge
description: Standard X3D 4.0 RigidBodyPhysics scenes on NVIDIA PhysX 5 (WASM) in the browser; the Marble Machine demo.

scripts.build: npm run vendor && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/copy-legal.mjs
scripts.validate: node tools/export-scenes.ts && ~/Projects/x3d/x3d_mcp/.venv/bin/python tools/validate_one.py scenes/*.x3d scenes/pieces/*.x3d scenes/experiments/*.x3d scenes/demos/*.x3d
